scaffold_status: Tag-free human biological domain consistent with Arkadash 2017 construct boundaries and seven mutation identities; not a reconstruction of the full vector fusion
partner_status: Explicit reproducible simulation constructs. These are canonical native active catalytic-region sequences, not a claim that all published wet-lab assays used identical boundaries.

constructs.boundary_rationale: Mature residues 1-127 as specified in Arkadash 2017 experimental procedures. UniProt signal peptide is 1-26, so mature Cys1 is precursor Cys27. Full 127-residue slice is identical to first 127 residues of the deposited human 4ILW TIMP2 entity. UniProt NTR annotation ends at 152; the literature construct deliberately includes precursor 153 (mature Glu127).
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Start at UniProt annotated mature chain 100. End at the annotated 22 kDa chain end 269, also the C-terminal mapped boundary in catalytic-domain structure 1CGL (mapped 101-269).
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Start at UniProt mature chain 110. End at catalytic-domain structure 1QIB mapped end 449. Use the entire contiguous native interval, retaining the three native fibronectin-II inserts; do not copy the engineered insertion-deleted sequence of 1QIB. Hemopexin repeats begin at 472.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: UniProt mature chain starts at 100. Both boundaries match catalytic-domain structure 1B3D mapping 100-272. Hemopexin repeats begin at 287.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Full UniProt mature chain 95-267; MMP7 lacks hemopexin. Retain all three native C-terminal residues after mapped 1MMQ end 264, rather than crop to resolved structure.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Start at UniProt mature chain 101, dropping propeptide residues 99-100 included by the 1JAN construct. End at catalytic-domain structure 1JAN mapped end 262. Hemopexin repeats begin at 276.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Start at the UniProt annotated 82 kDa mature chain 107. Use catalytic structure 1GKC mapped end 443; retain the entire contiguous native interval, including native fibronectin-II inserts deleted from the engineered 1GKC molecule. Hemopexin repeats begin at 518.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: UniProt mature chain starts at 104. Both boundaries match human MMP13 in TIMP2 complex structure 2E2D mapped 104-268. The TIMP2 in that complex is bovine, so it is not used as the scaffold sequence.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: Start at UniProt mature chain 112 and end at 1BUV catalytic chain M mapped end 287. Retain native 112-113 preceding its 114 start. Exclude hemopexin, transmembrane and cytoplasmic regions. TIMP2 chain T in 1BUV is bovine and is not the human scaffold.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions

constructs.boundary_rationale: UniProt mature chain starts at 99. Exact match to the 165-residue deposited human 4ILW MMP10 entity sequence and mapped interval 99-263; missing atomic coordinates do not delete residues from this sequence.
constructs.sequence_policy: Contiguous canonical UniProt parent slice; native residues only; no expression/purification tags or artificial substitutions
